summary.text: Rob Hall is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 67, which includes Tulsa County. He was elected for the 60th Legislature and was appointed vice chair of the Government Modernization and Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hall earned a mechanical engineering degree from the University of Tulsa in 2009.
He has since worked as an engineer and project manager for a Fortune 500 energy company, a college pastor, an investor in public markets, and an entrepreneur in the education sector.
The Speaker also appointed Hall to the Appropriations and Budget Natural Resources Subcommittee, the Commerce and Economic Development Oversight Committee, and the Common Education Committee.
His House biography says his primary policy areas include public infrastructure investment, the efficiency of state government, and an environment that fosters innovation.
Hall and his wife have three children and live in South Tulsa.
